exposure: US National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (NICHD) category of the associated fetal heart rate
marked variability in fetal heart rate (FHR)
Marked variability in fetal heart rate (FHR)
cohort: 4394 women in labor at ≥37 weeks of gestation, with continuous FHR monitoring until delivery and with the availability of umbilical arterial pH
finding: Marked variability in fetal heart rate in the 60 minutes before delivery was associated with a twofold increased risk of neonatal acidosis.
